hrv.start.title: Measure pulse
hrv.start.notSupported: Camera-based pulse measurement is currently only available in the iOS app.
hrv.start.noCamera: No suitable camera found. This measurement only works on a real iPhone.
hrv.start.instructions: Place your finger fully over the camera and flash — hold still until the measurement is complete.

hrv.measuring.hint.warmup: Rest your finger on the camera and flash. The actual measurement will start shortly.
hrv.measuring.hint.measure: Please hold still until the measurement is complete.
hrv.measuring.hint.noFinger: Finger not detected — please fully cover the camera and flash.
hrv.result.rmssdCaption.estimated: Short-term heart rate variability — estimate, with caveats
hrv.result.rmssdUnavailable: HRV (RMSSD) could not be reliably calculated — the signal was not clean and stable enough.
hrv.result.noReliableBody: The pulse could not be reliably detected. Please place your finger fully over the camera and flash and hold it still.
hrv.result.noFingerBody: The finger did not sit reliably on the camera and flash during the measurement. Please cover both fully and hold still.
